visual_logic.surface_detail: Smooth, dolphin-like skin with 'Indigo' dorsal tones and 'Cream' countershading. A subtle oily sheen suggests high-speed swimming, mapped uniformly across its full horizontal lateral flank.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the large, robust tail fluke and the specialized, paddle-like front flippers, which are extended parallel to the frame boundaries.
visual_logic.environment: Deep blue oceanic water of the Neuquén Basin; high visibility with drifting marine snow restricted to background layers to keep the outline clean.
visual_logic.pose: The platypterygiine ichthyosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original powerful lateral banking pose is stabilized into a flat, level cruising path, extending its streamlined snout, aerodynamic body, front flippers (flattened toward the camera plane), and large tail fluke end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
